note: WHOLE-FILE total, 712 lines (711 already recorded in cinema.json + 1 new). `Fire()` was missing cinema.js:932's UNCONDITIONAL `this._jitter = null` — the JS resets the shot-group jitter on EVERY `fire()` call, regardless of whether an explicit card index `i` was passed, while the ported `Fire(int? i = null)` only reset it inside the `if (i.HasValue) AimAt(i.Value)` branch (AimAt itself clears _jitter, cinema.js:925's own `aimAt(i)` call does the same thing cinema.js's fire() does belt-and-braces at line 932). Checked against every actual beat in BEATS1/BEATS2 (grep for `fire(` across cinema.js): every single scripted `fire(...)` call in both scenes passes an explicit index, so this divergence had NO effect on the two shipped scenes — but it is a real, provable gap against the JS spec (a future beat calling bare `fire()` would carry a stale jitter forward, scattering a shot onto last round's offset instead of a fresh one), and the task's own rule is to port the JS as written, not only the paths today's two scenes happen to exercise.
